description: Return the bound spend key’s policy headroom for the last 24 hours: daily remaining, pending, and paid. This is not the on-chain USDC wallet balance — use get_wallet_balance for that. Call this before pay_offering to check whether a pay would hit the daily cap. Related: get_wallet_balance, get_limits.

inputSchema.description: This tool takes no arguments. Authenticate with OAuth (Claude Sign in) or Authorization: Bearer vapt_… (Cursor).
inputSchema.title: NoArguments

name: get_spend_balance

outputSchema.description: Policy spend headroom for the bound spend key over the last 24 hours. Not the on-chain USDC wallet balance.

clientName.description: OAuth client name when authMode is oauth (e.g. Claude).

dailyCapUsd.description: Maximum USD this key may request in 24 hours.

label.description: Label the owner gave this spend key.

note.description: Reminder that this is not on-chain wallet balance.

perTxMaxUsd.description: Maximum USD this key may request in one pay.

remainingDailyUsd.description: dailyCapUsd minus spentLast24hUsd. Policy headroom only.

spentLast24hUsd.description: Pending plus paid USD started by this key in the last 24 hours.

outputSchema.title: SpendHeadroom

title: Get spend headroom
